name: How can I make my garage entry safer in addition to being accessible?

mainEntity.name: How can I make my garage entry safer in addition to being accessible?

acceptedAnswer.text: To make your garage entry safer alongside accessibility upgrades, consider several enhancements. Improve lighting with motion-sensor lights to illuminate the path effectively. Install non-slip flooring or mats, especially in areas prone to moisture. Ensure proper clearance for door operation to prevent accidental bumps. Adding an intercom system or smart doorbell can also enhance security. These measures combine to create a secure and accessible entry point.
acceptedAnswer.description: Enhance safety with motion-sensor lighting, non-slip flooring, clear door operation zones, and smart security features like intercoms or doorbells.
